a5: No. Spamlock can’t stop a company from being hacked, and it can’t change your accounts or settings for you. It finds what has leaked or needs attention, and guides you with simple steps you take yourself.
a6: Spamlock looks for new breaches in Have I Been Pwned’s list every day. If a new breach is found, it checks the emails you watch and tells you if one is included in the breached list.
a2: From Have I Been Pwned, a well-known public list of data breaches. Two-step sign-in options come from 2fa.directory, and link checks also use Google’s list of dangerous sites.

a3: Your email isn’t in any breach Have I Been Pwned knows about. New breaches are added often, so you can check again from time to time.
a1: Spamlock checks your emails, passwords, links and this phone for threats, and shows you simple steps to fix them.
plansFine: You see the price in the app before you buy. You can cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play settings.
a4: No. When you check a password, it never leaves the phone. Only a short scrambled piece is used to look it up.
